translations.legal.owner.heading: 1. Owner details
translations.legal.owner.intro: In accordance with Article 10 of Spanish Law 34/2002 on Information Society Services and Electronic Commerce (LSSI-CE), the details of the owner of this website are as follows:
translations.legal.use.heading: 2. Terms of use
translations.legal.use.body: Access to this website is free of charge and implies acceptance of this legal notice. The information published (menu, prices, opening hours) is for guidance only and may change without notice; if in doubt, please contact us directly.
translations.legal.ip.heading: 3. Intellectual and industrial property
translations.legal.ip.body: The texts, images, logos and design of this website belong to its owner or are used with permission. Reproduction, distribution or modification without prior written consent is not permitted.
translations.legal.liability.heading: 4. Liability and links
translations.legal.liability.body: The owner is not liable for service interruptions or for damage resulting from improper use of the website. This website may contain links to third-party sites, such as Google Maps, over whose content and privacy policies we have no control.
translations.legal.privacy.heading: 5. Data protection
translations.legal.privacy.body: The processing of personal data is explained in the {$START_LINK}privacy policy{$CLOSE_LINK}.
translations.legal.law.heading: 6. Governing law
translations.legal.law.body: This legal notice is governed by Spanish law. If you are a consumer, the courts of your place of residence shall have jurisdiction.
translations.legalPages.languageNote: This text is provided in several languages. In the event of any discrepancy, the Spanish version shall prevail.

translations.privacy.heading: Privacy policy
translations.privacy.controller.heading: 1. Data controller
translations.privacy.data.heading: 2. What data we process and why
translations.privacy.browsing.heading: Browsing the website
translations.privacy.browsing.body: When you visit the website, our hosting provider (Cloudflare) processes technical data about your connection, such as your IP address, date and time, the page requested and your browser type. We use this data only to serve the website and protect it against attacks and abuse.
translations.privacy.analytics.body: To find out how many visits the website receives we use Cloudflare Web Analytics, which does not use cookies or identify visitors: it only provides aggregated statistics (page views, country, device type).
translations.privacy.browsing.basis: Legal basis: our legitimate interest in providing a secure website and understanding how it is used (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR). Cloudflare keeps this technical data for a limited time in accordance with its own policy.
translations.privacy.contact.heading: Contact and bookings by email or phone
translations.privacy.contact.body: If you write to us or call us, we process the data you provide (name, email, phone number and the content of your message) in order to reply and, where applicable, manage your booking.
translations.privacy.contact.basis: Legal basis: handling your request or booking (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR). We keep this data for as long as necessary to assist you and for no more than one year afterwards, unless the law requires us to keep it longer.
translations.privacy.health.body: If you tell us about allergies or intolerances, this is considered health data. We use it only to adapt our service to you, with the explicit consent you give by telling us (Art. 9(2)(a) GDPR), and we delete it once the service has been provided.
translations.privacy.recipients.heading: 3. Recipients
translations.privacy.recipients.body: We do not share your data with third parties unless required by law. To provide our service we rely on the following providers, who act as data processors:
translations.privacy.recipients.cloudflare: Cloudflare, Inc. (USA): website hosting, security and visitor statistics.
translations.privacy.transfers.heading: 4. International transfers
translations.privacy.transfers.body: Cloudflare and Google may process data in the United States. These transfers are covered by the EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework and by the standard contractual clauses approved by the European Commission.
translations.privacy.cookies.heading: 5. Cookies
translations.privacy.cookies.body: This website does not use analytics or advertising cookies. If we add them in the future, we will let you know and ask for your consent before setting them.
translations.privacy.rights.heading: 6. Your rights
translations.privacy.rights.intro: You may exercise the following rights at any time by writing to us at {$INTERPOLATION}:
translations.privacy.rights.access: Access your data and obtain a copy.
translations.privacy.rights.erasure: Request the erasure of your data.
translations.privacy.rights.portability: Request the portability of your data in a structured format.
translations.privacy.rights.withdraw: Withdraw your consent, without affecting processing carried out beforehand.
translations.privacy.rights.identity: We may ask you to prove your identity in order to handle your request.
translations.privacy.rights.complaint: If you believe we have not processed your data correctly, you can lodge a complaint with the Spanish Data Protection Agency ({$START_LINK}www.aepd.es{$CLOSE_LINK}).
translations.privacy.minors.heading: 7. Minors
translations.privacy.minors.body: This website is not aimed at children under 14. If you are under that age, please do not give us personal data without the consent of your parents or guardians.
translations.privacy.changes.heading: 8. Changes to this policy
translations.privacy.changes.body: We may update this policy to reflect changes to the website or to the law. The date of the last update is shown at the top of this page.
